Question: When the World Wide Web first became popular in the 1990s, download speeds reached a maximum of about \(56\) kilobits per second. Approximately how many minutes would the download of a \(4.2\)-megabyte song have taken at that speed? (Note that there are \(8000\) kilobits in a megabyte.)
